name: Valdur
title: Voice of Elarite

synergy.description: Valdur shines in a full Elarite team, where enemies take damage when they move. Pallant, Metida, and Valdur move enemies with their skills, while Elarite Resonance deals extra damage whenever affected enemies change position.

description: Valdur is a mighty Summoner who completes the Elarite element and unleashes its true power. He interrupts enemy skills and keeps opponents taking damage by constantly moving them around the battlefield. With him in the fight, enemies struggle to put their plans into action.

skills.name: Child of Elarite
skills.description: Summons Child of Elarite at the center of the enemy team. It cannot move. Upon spawning, it knocks back enemies, dealing damage. After 4.0 seconds, Child of Elarite disappears, pulling enemies to itself and dealing damage. Child of Elarite is an Elarite Titan and cannot be attacked.

skills.name: Elarite Resonance
skills.description: Passive. Empowers allied Elarite Titans. Bonuses stack and depend on the number of Elarite Titans alive. With 2, grants extra damage to Water, Earth, and Fire Titans. With 3, grants extra defense against Water, Earth, and Fire Titans. With 4, Valdur receives 400 Energy when using skills. With 5, when an allied Elarite Titan deals damage to an enemy, the target suffers an effect for 4 seconds, taking damage every 0.5 seconds if they have changed position during that interval. With 6, reduces incoming damage by 50%.

bonuses_by_alive_elarite_titans.trigger: an allied Elarite Titan deals damage to an enemy
bonuses_by_alive_elarite_titans.damage_condition: The target has changed position during the interval.

scales_with: Number of living allied Elarite Titans

best_teams.name: Full Elarite
best_teams.notes: Pallant, Metida, and Valdur move enemies, enabling the movement damage from Elarite Resonance.

nota_pvp.resumo: Já estou com o Valdur na minha conta e ele se saiu muito bem nas batalhas que testei sem a Skin+, fora do Titans Brawls. Eu estava decepcionado com meus titãs Elarite: mesmo maximizados, eles chegavam a perder para times de iniciantes. Com a chegada do invocador Valdur, senti que o time ficou mais firme.
nota_pvp.titans_brawls: No evento Titans Brawls, o time Elarite com Valdur também segurou uma defesa contra um time full Luz, algo que eu ainda não tinha conseguido.
nota_pvp.proximo_video: Ainda estou testando. Meu próximo vídeo vai ser um guia completo dos melhores times do Valdur que encontrei. Inscreva-se no canal e ative o sininho para não perder!

developer_notes.title: Notas extras dos desenvolvedores sobre Valdur
developer_notes.overview: Here are a few tips to help you figure Valdur out faster. Valdur is the Elarite Summoner, and the idea behind him is simple: the enemy moved, the enemy took damage. He breaks enemy casts with his ultimate, and in the right team he punishes every step the enemy takes.
child_of_elarite: Valdur summons the Child of Elarite right in the middle of the enemy team. When it appears, it pushes enemies away and deals damage. A few seconds later it disappears, pulls everyone back in and hits them again. All that shoving can interrupt enemy skills mid-cast, and that's probably the easiest thing to catch on video.

The Child doesn't move and can't be attacked. Even if Valdur falls first, the Child still pulls enemies back when it disappears. It also counts as an Elarite titan, so keep it in mind for the next part.

elarite_resonance.overview: This passive buffs allied Elarite titans, and the bonuses stack with the number of living Elarite titans.

tiers.bonus: Extra attack against Water, Earth and Fire titans.
Valdur gets extra energy when he uses skills.
Every hit from an allied Elarite titan marks the enemy, and a marked enemy takes damage each time its position changes.

elarite_resonance.notes: The fifth tier is where the pack comes alive. On his own, Valdur only pushes and pulls. With a full Elarite team behind him, every push and pull turns into extra hits.

team_suggestions.synergy: Pallant and Metida move enemies with their skills too. In a full Elarite team their skills also trigger the position damage, so three titans out of five keep shoving the enemy around and every move costs them.
teams: Full Elarite team: Valdur, Pallant, Metida, Orm and Alecto. Start in attack, that's where it shows off best.
Valdur and Metida with fire titans, worth a try when the enemy brings a lot of Earth.

video_ideas: The same fight with two, three, four and five Elarite titans, so viewers see each Resonance tier switch on.
A slowed down replay of Child of Elarite breaking an enemy cast.
Valdur in attack and in defense against different enemy teams. Tell your audience where he shines and how you'd build around him.
